purpose: Finite source registry proposal for an explicit inapplicable skipped-job role; no execution-pass or native qualification claim.

sourceVerification.mode: Remote Git blob reads into RAM; each decoded byte sequence verified against its Git SHA1 and recorded length/SHA256; Prettier YAML AST extraction only.
sourceVerification.exactSourceBodies: Retrievable by each immutable Git blob identity recorded in registry.

schema.condition: Exact parsed YAML if scalar, or null for an absent explicit if; descriptive evidence, never a runtime general expression evaluator.
schema.checkNames: Finite observed skipped-job names, not prefixes, regexes, or arbitrary matrix expansion.

common: Only for a completed skipped check and completed skipped job bound to the same exact run/attempt/head/repository/workflow ID/path, verified pull_request event and unique exact PR association.
Require positive integer candidate PR identity and verified candidate head; missing or conflicting identities fail closed.
Require exact registered source blob. Changed or unknown path/blob/job/name is ineligible.
Every same-source candidate job matching an ambiguous display name must prove inapplicable; one matching rule never authorizes another eligible job.
All requiredSuccessfulJobs must be completed success in the same run and independently check-bound; their own null-proof records cannot be exempted.
Keep existing source-policy skip proof separate, with its existing required evidence; no registry role for deploy test/build or release-ready.
Preserve two independent sweeps and the 64-request bound. This registry does not change collection limits, policy scope, or manual native protocol bytes.
proofSemantics.manualOnly: Pinned root conditions require workflow_dispatch as an AND term, while the observed and associated run must be pull_request. Reject workflow_dispatch, push, pull_request_target, unknown or missing events.
proofSemantics.otherPR: Pinned frozen protocol root conditions require PR1544 as an AND term. Only a verified positive integer candidate PR different from1544 may be proved inapplicable. Deny PR1544 at every head, including the original eligible before/head combination; fixed before SHA and event action are never used as an alternate exemption.
proofSemantics.needsInapplicable: Pinned dependent has no explicit if and exact needs:['declare']; its same-source declare root has a direct manual-only or other-pr proof. Require the prerequisite dependency proof to close. No support for always(), custom conditional descendants, empty or unknown dependencies, cycles, or arbitrary transitive runtime expressions.
proofSemantics.requiredSourceGuard: published-pages-smoke requires source success; every solo-native-package-consumer exemption requires replay-portability-source success. This includes manual jobs not declaring that source job in YAML needs as a conservative collector guard.

staticCensusCoverage.label: Static mapping of retained source and check metadata, not controller execution, CI validation, or current status refresh.

requiredUnexecutedControls: Original PR1544 is refused at every head for frozen protocols, including originally eligible condition values.
Candidate PR absent, noninteger, zero, mismatch, duplicate or conflicting run association fails closed.
workflow_dispatch/push/pull_request_target or wrong repo/head/base/workflow identity cannot use this role.
Changed workflow blob, unregistered path, unknown job, extra matrix name or same name in another workflow fails closed.
Null-proof source guards remain required and cannot be exempted; wrong run/attempt/head/check binding or non-success guard fails.
Ambiguous display name with any eligible or unproven sibling fails closed; all valid inapplicable siblings are accepted only with complete joins.
Dependent condition changed to always/custom if, changed needs, missing root, cyclic root or unproved root fails closed.
Incomplete, duplicate, contradictory, stale-attempt or paginated job metadata fails closed without elevating request limits.
Two sweeps must agree on source/run/association/job/check evidence; changes or omissions fail closed.
integrationCaveat: The registry proves conditions in exact source bytes. The collector must separately establish that its selected source is authoritative for the evaluated run. PR merge-revision execution and candidate-head identity are distinct; a candidate-head directory blob alone must not be described as proof of executed merge-revision bytes. Existing trusted-source binding must close this distinction or the collector must conservatively reject the unresolved case.

primarySources.finding: A skipped dependency normally skips jobs needing it unless a conditional allows continuation.
Job-level conditions are evaluated before matrix expansion; this explains observed unexpanded skipped names but does not authorize wildcard matching.
The pull_request event uses the PR merge ref/commit; head.sha identifies the head separately.
